_comment: Persona A with the caffeine cut at 75% (52.5 mg) instead of 50%, seed 7: a seed repeat asking the nine report questions of A's 3000-step run.
1500 training steps since 2026-11-24, as every Qwen3-32B file: 6 checkpoints, one every 250. The Qwen3-8B files train 3000. Where a note below says 3000 steps, read 1500 for this file.
weights: caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31
screen: caffeine_content at 75% of its range (52.5 mg per cup, of 0 to 70)
data: data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/rule_tests/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold_cut75/ (persona A's input files, only the first row of instilled_weights.csv changed; A's seeds).

settings from configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/rule_tests/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold_cut75_40gb.json; report_schema from configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_no_trial_a.json (nine questions, "{" reply prefix, C shown), as the seed repeats of A and A-inverse at the 50% cut, which these runs read beside.
The base model is scored before training (baseline_before_training true): Qwen/Qwen3-32B has no base-model evaluation yet.

No cut probe among the nine questions: ask cut_probe_caffeine_full of the saved checkpoints with evaluate_checkpoints.ipynb, QUESTIONS_FROM = "configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/rule_tests/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold_cut75_40gb.json".
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.
Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-32B on a 80 GB card (A100 80GB, H100): micro_batch_size 5, eval batches 16 (decision 16, introspection 4). Out of memory: eval batches 8.
